claims.evidence: No import paperwork, customs sticker, or shipping documents visible in the photo.
No brand name, model plate, or logo is readable in the image; witness could only identify it by type.
No customs receipt, duty certificate, or clearance document shown.
Wheels are detached and lying separately; tread condition and tyre brand/newness cannot be assessed from the image.
The trike is shown partially disassembled with wheels removed and loose parts scattered, indicating it has been taken apart.

risks.proof: Video of engine running, plus close-up photos of engine block and drivetrain components reassembled
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / needs full mechanical inspection

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete parts after disassembly
risks.proof: Full parts checklist with photos of each component (body panels, wiring harness, brackets) laid out and matched to a reference diagram
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, assume missing parts to be sourced

risks.risk: Frame or structural damage from accident or disassembly
risks.proof: Clear photos of frame/chassis from multiple angles, especially joints and welds

risks.risk: No proof of ownership or registration documents
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle registration/title and seller's ID matching the name on documents
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered/risky title, legal risk discount

risks.risk: Actual tyre and brake condition unverifiable due to detached wheels
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre tread (brand, DOT date) and brake pads/discs
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn tyres/brakes needing replacement

risks.risk: Reason for disassembly (repair vs. damage vs. transport) unknown
risks.proof: Seller explanation with supporting before/after photos or repair invoice
risks.if_unproven: priced as disassembled due to damage, worst case

risks.risk: True identity/model (Ryker vs generic trike) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Clear photo of VIN plate, model badge, or manufacturer sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded trike, not premium Ryker model

proof_requests: Clear photo of VIN/chassis number and model/brand plate
Video of engine starting and running
Photos of registration/ownership documents and customs duty certificate
Close-up photos of both detached wheels showing tyre tread and brand
Full set of photos of all loose parts laid out and matched to original assembly diagram
Photos of frame/chassis joints and undercarriage for rust or damage
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a three-wheeled trike, so it can be priced, but disassembly, unreadable brand/model, and lack of documentation mean it must be priced at worst case (unverified completeness, condition, and authenticity) until the listed proofs are provided.
